audit.whatIsWrong: Dark Procession is described everywhere as a cage you must avoid, and nowhere as a destructible wall. Mourning Mist's armour reduction is also never mentioned, and Last Rites is never identified as an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Riot's text: Dark Procession 'summons a destructible wall' - you can break out rather than wait it out, which changes every caged fight. Mourning Mist 'reduces armor, damages, slows and marks', so the mark is an armour shred as well as a homing beacon. Last Rites is flagged autoReset, so the attack wind-up is the tell for his burst.
audit.corrected: Hit the wall, it breaks; sidestep the 700-range Mourning Mist because it shreds armour before the ghouls arrive; read the Last Rites wind-up.
sources: champ-data/_kits/yorick.json (W terrain/destructible, E projectile+slow+armour, Q autoReset+heal)

audit.whatIsWrong: Rated HARD 7.5/10 with six of seven stages given to Yorick, against a 53.11% Cho'Gath win rate over 644 games and prose that says 'this is where you stabilize and then take over' from 4-5 onward.
audit.why: The chart contradicted both the win rate and the page's own mid-game text. Yorick's genuine claim is level 2-3 and the two-item split.
audit.corrected: EVEN, 5.5/10; chart Skill / Yorick / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Yorick with ratings 5,4,6,6,7,7,3.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns were attached to any of his tools.
audit.why: Mourning Mist is 12/11/10/9/8s, Dark Procession 20/18/16/14/12s, Last Rites 6 down to 4s, and Eulogy of the Isles 160/130/100s. The 160-second ultimate in particular means the Maiden window is something you wait out rather than fight through.
audit.corrected: Trade on Mourning Mist's 12 seconds, all-in when the cage is on 20, and avoid the fight while the Maiden is up.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was never named for this matchup despite Last Rites healing on every use.
audit.why: Last Rites heals him on a 6-to-4-second cooldown, which is what carries him through the extended trades the page tells you to force.
audit.corrected: Named Grievous Wounds against Last Rites in the dos.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are Yorick's window, not yours. His E (Mourning Mist) slows and MARKS you so every ghoul and his autos home in for a chunk, and his Q heal gives him trade weight before your Q-W combo even exists. Note his E is the homing missile and his W (Dark Procession) is the cage wall — don't confuse them. Don't walk up to last-hit into the mark; soak the wave with Vorpal Spikes (E) cone clear at range and lean on Carnivore's kill-sustain to stay topped up. Sidestep the Mourning Mist when you can, and once his ghouls are spent you get a window — but until then concede the push and farm.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are Yorick's window, not yours. Mourning Mist slows, MARKS you so every ghoul and auto homes in, and reduces your armour before the swarm even arrives, and Last Rites is an auto-attack reset that heals him, so the wind-up is your cue to back off. Note his E is the homing globule and his W is the wall - and that wall is destructible, so if he cages you, hit it rather than stand there. Don't walk up to last-hit into the mark; soak the wave with Vorpal Spikes at range and lean on Carnivore to stay topped up. Once his ghouls are spent you get a window, and Mourning Mist is 12 seconds at rank 1.

edits.before: Your first-item spike still owns the straight duel — HP components plus Feast stacks let you facetank the ghoul swarm and out-sustain him — so force fights and snowball before he scales. But Yorick is the textbook splitpush problem: at 2+ items his Maiden of the Mist, full ghoul army, and W cage let him zone you off the side wave and out-pressure the whole map. Win the lane and group early so his split never decides the game, and never get walled into a 1v1 sidelane where his pets and Maiden swarm you down.

notes: I left one existing claim alone because I cannot verify it: the page says Feast can 'snap off his Maiden' (spikes[1], whys[3]). Feast's description is 'Devours an enemy unit', which does not settle whether the Maiden of the Mist is a valid Feast target or whether killing her grants a stack, and needsResearch is empty rather than negative. Flagged rather than rewritten. Also: chogath.json tags Rupture (Q) with grounding, a tooltip-parse misfire on the words 'Ruptures the ground' (the same false positive hits Malphite Q and Olaf Q), so I did not claim Rupture grounds anything of his.
